name: dns-worker
description: Privacy-first DNS & DoH Resolver with modern Web Dashboard, built for Cloudflare Workers & Node.js

scripts.dev: bun run db:migrate:dev && concurrently "bun run ui:dev" "wrangler dev"
scripts.build:serverfull: bun run ui:build && bunx esbuild src/serverfull/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/serverfull.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --external:node:sqlite
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run db:migrate:prod && wrangler deploy
scripts.build:pages: bun run ui:build && bunx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=static/_worker.js --platform=neutral --format=esm --minify --external:cloudflare:* --external:node:*
scripts.db:migrate:prod: echo "y" | wrangler d1 migrations apply dns_worker_db --remote
scripts.db:status: wrangler d1 execute dns_worker_db --local --command='SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table"'

author: Hugo Koo
